svg.text: Cut 120 x 70 mm from 6 mm plate; deburr. Mark a centre cross;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the long centre line is the pod's axis (it points along the gutter).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot: one 8.5 mm hole at the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pod bolts: two holes on the long centre line, 30 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre; drill 5 mm and tap M6.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot: a curved slot 6.5 mm wide on a 35 mm radius about the centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from 25 to 49 degrees off the long centre line, on the side away

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the house and toward the pod's east (back) end. Chain drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The front pod's plate and the back pod's plate are mirror images.
